children: The Turkish banking watchdog (BDDK) chairman Sahap Kavcioglu said on Wednesday he had submitted his resignation to President Tayyip Erdogan.
Kavcioglu said on X that he had asked for permission to step down "in light of the recent allegations concerning the Banking Regulation and Supervision Agency and myself."
